# BR-001 — Holiday Cake Online Pre-orders

## References

### Derived From

- None identified.

### Related To

- None identified.

### Supporting Artifacts

- None identified.

## Business Context and Problem

The regional bakery chain takes orders by phone. The user reports that phone orders are error-prone and staff are overwhelmed in December. Customers are affected by incorrect orders, while the owner and store managers have an interest in improving order accuracy and managing seasonal workload.

The user estimates that about 10% of orders were wrong last year. This is an unverified estimate, not a measured baseline; the definition of an incorrect order, the order population and supporting records are TBD. Financial impact and order volumes are TBD. Source: the user's business brief for this draft.

## Objectives and Desired Outcomes

- Reduce errors in holiday cake pre-orders.
- Reduce the December workload associated with taking and managing orders.
- Enable customers to place holiday cake pre-orders online.

Quantitative success targets are TBD.

## Stakeholders

| Stakeholder | Interest or role |
|---|---|
| Owner | Business stakeholder; funding and approval authority TBD. |
| Store managers | Business stakeholders affected by order accuracy and December workload; decision responsibilities TBD. |
| Customers | Affected by order errors and the proposed online pre-order service. |
| Store staff | Affected group identified in the problem statement: overwhelmed during December; involvement in planning TBD. |

## Scope

### In Scope

- Online pre-orders for holiday cakes only.

### Out of Scope

- Delivery.
- Products other than cakes.

Participating stores, eligible cakes and the holiday ordering period are TBD. Whether phone orders continue alongside online pre-orders is TBD.

## Current Process

Orders are currently taken by phone. Further details of order recording, checking and fulfillment are TBD.

## Business Requirements

- **BR-001-R001** — Customers must be able to place holiday cake pre-orders online with the bakery chain.
- **BR-001-R002** — The business must improve holiday cake pre-order accuracy relative to the current phone-order process; the measured baseline and improvement target are TBD.
- **BR-001-R003** — The business must reduce the burden of holiday cake order handling on staff during December; the workload baseline and reduction target are TBD.

## Constraints and Dependencies

- Launch must occur before next December, as stated by the user. The exact calendar deadline and intended year are TBD; no specific date has been assumed.
- Budget: TBD.
- Payment rules: TBD; no payment timing or method has been decided.
- Store readiness, staffing capacity and any system dependencies: TBD.
- Other applicable business or regulatory constraints: TBD.

## Success Measures

The following measurement areas reflect the stated problems; measurement definitions and targets remain undecided.

| Outcome | Baseline | Target | Measurement method and timing |
|---|---|---|---|
| Improved order accuracy | About 10% wrong last year, per user estimate; validation and comparability with holiday cake pre-orders TBD | TBD | Error definition, order population, data source and review period TBD |
| Reduced December staff workload | Staff reported as overwhelmed; quantitative baseline TBD | TBD | Workload measure, data source and review period TBD |

Owners for measuring success are TBD. Meeting the launch constraint alone does not establish achievement of the business outcomes.

## Assumptions and Risks

- **Unverified estimate:** The reported 10% error rate is the user's estimate and needs validation before use as a measured baseline.
- **Risk:** Undefined success targets make it difficult to determine whether the change achieves its intended outcomes.
- **Risk:** An unresolved budget, payment policy and launch deadline may affect the achievable scope and schedule.
- **Risk:** The effect on staff workload is uncertain until the future order-handling process and any continued phone ordering are defined.
- **Material tradeoffs:** The balance between launch timing, available funding and operational scope is TBD. No tradeoff decision is recorded.

## Open Questions

All items below remain TBD; assigned owners and resolution dates are also TBD. They are recorded for later resolution, not as prerequisites to writing this draft.

- Ordering limits, lead times and fulfillment arrangements within the no-delivery scope.
- Whether phone ordering continues and how staff will handle orders across channels.
- Operational readiness, system dependencies and other applicable constraints.
